scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @blockcraft/server" "npm run dev -w @blockcraft/client"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @blockcraft/protocol && npm run build -w @blockcraft/voxel-world
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @blockcraft/client && npm run build -w @blockcraft/server
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
